Blend with Mascara: After the adhesive has fully dried, gently apply another coat of mascara to blend your natural lashes with the false lashes. This helps create a seamless look and adds extra volume.

MARS Microfiber Velvet Beauty Blend is designed with ultra-soft, microfiber material that effortlessly blends and buffs makeup for a flawless, airbrushed finish.
It is made from microfiber, a synthetic material known for its softness, absorbency, and ability to blend makeup seamlessly.
Microfiber beauty blenders often have a velvety texture that feels smooth and luxurious on the skin. This texture helps to distribute and blend liquid and cream products evenly without streaking.
They are durable and resistant to wear and tear, providing long-lasting use without needing frequent replacement.
They are easy to clean with mild soap and water or a gentle makeup brush cleanser. Microfiber beauty blenders dry quickly, which helps to prevent mold and bacteria buildup.

Dip the damp microfiber velvet beauty blender into the product. Use the rounded bottom or the sides of the blender to dab the makeup onto your face. Start with light dabbing motions to distribute the product evenly.
Use gentle bouncing or stippling motions to blend the makeup into your skin. The microfiber texture helps to seamlessly blend the product for a natural finish without streaks.
Use the pointed tip or edges of the microfiber blender to blend makeup around the contours of your face, such as around the nose, under the eyes, and along the jawline.
After each use, rinse the microfiber velvet beauty blender with water and mild soap or a gentle brush cleanser. Gently squeeze out excess water and allow it to air dry completely before storing.

MARS #fabulash eyelashes are the ultimate cherry-on-the-top of any eye look. They are lightweight and perfectly shaped to fit every eye shape and can be used multiple times.
They are a mix of natural and heavy lashes.
You can wear them everyday or in parties.
These lashes have a thin band.
Prepare Your Natural Lashes: Curl your natural lashes and apply mascara before applying false eyelashes. This helps create a base and lift for easier blending with the false lashes.
Trim the False Lashes (if needed): Measure the false lashes against your eyelid and trim any excess from the outer edge if they are too long for your eye shape.

Apply Eyelash Adhesive: Using a small amount of eyelash adhesive (preferably latex-free), apply a thin line along the base of the false lashes. Wait a few seconds for the adhesive to become tacky, which makes it easier to stick to your eyelid.

Position the Lashes: Using tweezers or your fingers, gently place the false lashes as close to your natural lash line as possible. Start from the center of your eye and then press down the inner and outer corners.
Press and Secure: Once the false lashes are in place, gently press along the lash line to secure them. Ensure they are firmly attached and sit comfortably on your eyelid.

Blend with Mascara: After the adhesive has fully dried, gently apply another coat of mascara to blend your natural lashes with the false lashes. This helps create a seamless look and adds extra volume.
